payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_adopt_stack_layer.py::test_an_adopted_task_that_ran_after_every_layer_becomes_its_batchs_top_layer stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The `stack_layers` row written with SQL and no fact, so a fold loses it.' applied to saffron/ledger.py as an edit. The claim was "When `saffron adopt`'s re-gate moves a task of a stack batch to `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, and the task ran after every layer the batch holds, adopt records it as that batch's top layer. Its position is one more than the top layer's, or 1 when the batch holds no layer. Its predecessor is the top layer's task, or none. Its generation is 0 for a task of the stack order. Adopt writes it through `Ledger.record_stack_layer`, so a fold of the record rebuilds it, and prints a line holding `layer <position> of batch <batch id>`. The witness drives a batch holding no layer and a batch whose two layers both ran before the task. It checks the predecessor's key and head. It sees `saffron finish` refuse the empty batch with `holds no layer` before the adopt, and pass that check after it.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_batch.py::test_a_stack_batch_records_one_layer_for_each_task_that_reached_review, tests/test_batch.py::test_the_stack_layers_fold_back_from_the_record_alone, tests/test_batch.py::test_a_stack_batchs_layer_and_spec_review_facts_reach_the_origin_at_exit, tests/test_end_review.py::test_each_layers_end_review_folds_back_from_the_record, tests/test_ledger.py::test_a_stack_finish_is_one_fact_under_the_top_layer_and_folds_back_by_batch, tests/test_ledger_events.py::test_each_fact_the_ledger_appends_emits_one_event_naming_its_kind_and_key, tests/test_ledger_events.py::test_a_ledger_with_no_record_emits_no_event, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
